# rediscloud_iris_identity_api_key (Resource)

Manages an API key and its permission grants through the direct Iris Identity Service API. The generated token is returned only at creation and retained in Terraform state through refresh and updates. To replace a token, create another key resource, update consumers, then delete the old resource. Import is not supported because existing tokens cannot be recovered. Grant and action order does not matter. Constraint configuration is not supported. Keys with service-managed constraints can be refreshed, renamed and deleted with a warning. Grant-policy updates are blocked while constraints are present so Terraform cannot discard those restrictions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rediscloud_iris_identity_api_key" "example" {
  name       = "application-runtime"
  expires_at = 0
  tenant     = "your-tenant"

  grant {
    product       = "memory"
    resource_type = "mem-store"
    resource_id   = rediscloud_iris_agent_memory.example.id
    actions       = ["read", "write"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `expires_at` (Number) Future Unix timestamp at which Iris deletes the key; 0 or omitted means never. After expiry, configure a new future timestamp or 0 before recreating the key; Iris rejects a past timestamp at creation, and changing the expiry of an existing key to a past timestamp is rejected during planning. Fixed past timestamps are never extended automatically.
- `grant` (Block Set) Permissions granted to the key. At least one grant is required; constraints are not supported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--grant))
- `tenant` (String) Tenant that owns the key and all of its grants; Iris allows one tenant per key and requires every store in a grant to belong to it. Omit it to use the service default at creation. Changing it replaces the key, as does a value that is only known at apply time, because Iris cannot move a key between tenants. Case is preserved; surrounding whitespace is not allowed.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_id` (String) The user that the key acts as. Optional: a key without a user acts as no user. Changing or removing the user replaces the key. Requires API key user binding to be enabled in the deployment. Administrators can set any user; any other caller can set only their own user ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number)
- `id` (String) Identity Service key identifier.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Generated API key token, available only at creation and retained in Terraform state.

<a id="nestedblock--grant"></a>
### Nested Schema for `grant`

Required:

- `actions` (Set of String) Allowed actions for this resource.
- `product` (String) Lowercase Iris product without surrounding whitespace, for example memory.
- `resource_id` (String) The exact resource identifier.
- `resource_type` (String) Lowercase product resource type without surrounding whitespace. Use mem-store for Agent Memory.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
